profile.name: USBTMC通信抽象组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于以简化的类VISA接口与支持USBTMC的实验仪器通信。它在实验自动化中提供基本的写入、读取和查询能力，适合把命令转发到示波器、万用表、电源等兼容USBTMC的设备。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that provides a minimal VISA-like interface for communicating with USBTMC-capable laboratory instruments. In lab automation, it offers basic write, read, and query operations for forwarding commands to compatible devices such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies.

registry.name: USB TMC Instrument
registry.description: USB TMC Instrument Interface是由Open Standard (USBTMC)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、读取数据。
